messages:
Marie: Hey @eng-security — opened PR  #4321 that touches on onprem auth surface, could use a quick security skim. TL;DR: adds SERVICE_SA_TOKEN env + fallback to vault secret path if projection fails. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321

Marie: Key questions: 1) is projecting the SA here ok for onprem (we're only using it to call local KMS proxy)? 2) do we need any VPC egress allowlist entries to reach the proxy from the cluster? 3) any secret scoping or rotation notes I missed?

sec-bot: Automated scan: no plaintext secrets detected in diff. Dependency check: ok. Reminder: ensure KMS paths follow least-priv rule.

Simon: taking a look. Quick Q — what's the token lifetime and audience? If it's long-lived we should avoid baking it into images or envs.

Marie: good point — token projected at runtime, TTL=1h, refreshed by sidecar. Not baked.

Tony: Does the sidecar exchange call go out to the public internet or to our private KMS proxy endpoint in the same VPC? If public, we need network review + egress allowlist.

Marie: it targets internal kms-proxy.svc.cluster.local which then forwards to corporate-kms in the customer VPC via peering. So egress is inside our VPC peering path, but we might need explicit route in some onprem customers (notes in PR).

Leah: For onprem deployments we should add a short runbook: 1) ensure route to corporate-kms exists, 2) verify proxy config for mutual TLS, 3) confirm audit logging enabled. I can draft.

Anika: Also add a comment in code to avoid env var leakage in crash logs. Better to mount as projected volume where possible.

Marie: updated PR with a note about projected volume as fallback and a small docs blurb on routes. PTAL.

Simon: I skimmed the diff — looks fine but please add an entry in the security changelog mentioning the fallback to vault and who to contact if key rotation happens. Also add a test for the sidecar refresh path.

Marie: will add changelog + unit test. ETA later today.

Olivia: LGTM from infra side — verified no extra IAM scopes are requested. :thumbsup:

Simon: :thumbsup: from sec as long as changelog + test land before merge.

Marie: Thanks all. I'll push the test/changelog and request merge window tomorrow morning (canary slot).

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-06-18 08:30UTC pending final merge.

Tony: one last note — for customers running in stricter onprem, include a quick checklist in the PR description on networking and KMS endpoint configuration to avoid last-minute support tickets.

Marie: added checklist in PR description. Thanks everyone.
